name_zh: 菲律宾·里萨尔：医生小说家与革命殉道教育
name_en: Philippines Rizal: Doctor Novelist & Revolutionary Martyrdom Education
description_zh: 何塞·里萨尔 (1861-1896) 菲律宾民族英雄，眼科医生小说家，《诺里梅唐雷》《费利比斯泰莫》唤醒民族意识，1896年被西班牙殖民当局处决，殉道点燃革命。
description_en: Jose Rizal (1861-1896) Philippines national hero, ophthalmologist novelist, Noli Me Tangere El Filibusterismo awakened national consciousness, 1896 executed by Spanish colonial authorities, martyrdom ignited revolution.
reason_zh: 里萨尔代表启蒙知识分子如何通过文学与科学双重身份唤醒民族，展示了非暴力思想启蒙如何在殖民压迫下转化为革命精神火种，其处决成为菲律宾独立精神图腾。
reason_en: Rizal represents how enlightenment intellectual awakens nation through dual literary-scientific identity, demonstrating how non-violent intellectual enlightenment transforms into revolutionary spiritual spark under colonial oppression, his execution becoming Philippines independence spiritual totem.
steps_zh: 研究里萨尔早年马尼拉马德里海德堡留学医学文学
分析《诺里梅唐雷》暴露修士腐败与《费利比斯泰莫》革命预言
探讨拉利加菲利平和改良与达皮坦流放科研
评估1896年革命爆发与巴古安扬处决殉道升华
总结医生小说家革命殉道教育对菲律宾民族主义的永恒塑造
steps_en: Study Rizal early Manila Madrid Heidelberg medical literature studies
Analyze Noli Me Tangere exposing friar corruption and El Filibusterismo revolution prophecy
Explore La Liga Filipina peaceful reform and Dapitan exile scientific research
Evaluate 1896 revolution outbreak and Bagumbayan execution martyrdom elevation
Summarize doctor novelist revolutionary martyrdom education eternal shaping of Filipino nationalism
expected_zh: 掌握文学启蒙与科学理性双重武器如何击碎殖民精神枷锁，理解殉道者如何成为民族想象共同体永恒精神锚点，评估里萨尔对菲律宾教育体系的决定性制度化遗产。
expected_en: Master how literary enlightenment and scientific rationality dual weapons shattered colonial spiritual shackles, understand how martyr becomes eternal spiritual anchor of national imagined community, evaluate Rizal decisive institutionalization legacy for Philippine education system.
case_zh: 1861 出生；1887 诺里梅；1891 费利比；1896 处决。医生小说家革命殉道范式永存。
case_en: 1861 birth; 1887 Noli; 1891 Fili; 1896 execution. Doctor novelist revolutionary martyrdom paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Filipino Enlightenment / Propaganda Movement / Literary Nationalism
cross_cultural_impact: National hero; literary nationalism; peaceful reform; martyrdom education
